{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
filtered = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered = filtered[filtered['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered['revenue'].mean()

# Output result
mean_revenue"}
